upload_validation.description: Multi-layer extension and MIME inspection, rejecting empty files and non-audio streams.

file_size_limits.description: Enforces MAX_UPLOAD_MB (50MB default) using byte stream bounds checks returning HTTP 413.

duration_limits.description: Enforces MAX_AUDIO_DURATION_SECONDS (120s default) inside canonical preprocessing returning HTTP 400.

path_traversal_protection.description: Sanitizes untrusted filenames, strips ../ and ..\\ sequences, uses UUID tempfiles.

temporary_file_cleanup.description: Guaranteed try/finally file deletion with garbage collection retry mechanism.

structured_error_responses.description: Uniform JSON format with error codes, messages, and unique request_id without leaking internal stack traces.

global_exception_handling.description: Catches unhandled server exceptions, logs tracebacks server-side, returns sanitized HTTP 500.

request_id_tracing.description: Generates UUID4 per request, injected into response header X-Request-ID and logs.

model_integrity_verification.description: Calculates SHA-256 checksum on load and flags MODEL_INTEGRITY_FAILURE on metadata mismatch.

health_and_readiness_probes.description: Exposes /api/health (liveness probe) and /api/ready (readiness probe verifying model state).

security_headers.description: Sets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Referrer-Policy, and CSP.

concurrency_and_resource_limits.description: Asyncio Semaphore throttles concurrent inference jobs; asyncio.wait_for enforces timeout limits.
